rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_unconstrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.73979, n_angles=2304, n_det=736, det_spacing=1.285044, sod=595.362, sdd=1086.803, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.05, train_n=400, val_n=214, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_unconstrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=16, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.5, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.9, dataset_kind=mayo_ldct_2d, rationale=iter-4: lower fd_recon_init_t 0.7->0.5 to start the few-step flow closer to the FBP anchor and preserve PSNR (less prior-drift away from the data solution where PSNR lives). Confirming probe: the pixel-CONSTRAINED sibling mapped this exact move at its iter-4 and gained +0.28 dB (31.97->32.25 at NFE=8). Unconstrained iter-3 sits at 32.41 dB, ~1.7 dB under the 34.08 LD-FBP PSNR floor that gates hr; a ~0.3 dB init_t lever cannot close a ~1.7 dB structural gap, so this validates regime-bound rather than expecting hr>0. NFE held at 16, dc_relax 0.9, eta 1.0 from base iter-3.
